# SOP-P3-L2-02 Product changeover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Related documents: MM-P3-L2-RR02, SB-1041, SOP-P3-L2-01

Preconditions
1. Machine safety interlocks verified and locked per SB-1041.  
2. Material for incoming product staged and traceability labels applied.  
3. Operators assigned and trained per SOP-P3-L2-01.

PPE
1. Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and steel-toe boots required.  
2. Heat-resistant gloves must be used when handling parts leaving EQ-P3-L2-HT03.

Changeover procedure
1. Stop production on EQ-P3-L2-SB01 and isolate power following SB-1041.  
2. Configure EQ-P3-L2-RR02 for new product profile specified in MM-P3-L2-RR02. Verify tooling clearance visually and confirm no foreign objects present. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.  
3. Set incoming billet feed staging and confirm feed orientation matches MM-P3-L2-RR02.  
4. Load new mandrel and backup tooling; hand-tighten fasteners, then perform final secure per operator checklist in MM-P3-L2-RR02.  
5. Energize systems and perform dry-cycle at low feed to verify motion paths without material. Monitor for abnormal noises or interlock faults.  
6. Start trial run with single billet. Inspect ring geometry and surface finish against MM-P3-L2-RR02 acceptance criteria. Repeat trial until criteria met.  
7. Place approved parts into quarantine for heat treatment. Process parts through EQ-P3-L2-HT03 following SOP-P3-L2-01. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.  
8. Release initial production lot to quality if all inspections pass and records are complete.

Sign-off
1. Operator: _______________________ Date: __________________  
2. Shift Lead: _____________________ Date: __________________  
3. Quality Inspector: _______________ Date: __________________

Records
1. Attach trial run inspection sheets and MM-P3-L2-RR02 checklist to this SOP sign-off.
